_about: Prompt kit for section concepts, from design-system/inspiration/style-atlas/STYLE-ATLAS.md section 8. pre + mid + suf is what Gemini receives; mid comes from section_prompts.py. Edit directions to steer variety; keep the base and negatives in step with the atlas.
pre: Generate an image. A 1440 px wide desktop website section, flat straight-on UI mockup, no device frame, no people. Aquemi, maker of modular polypropylene Purified Water systems for pharmaceutical plants. Palette: deep navy (#0F2A47) and warm limestone off-white grounds, pure white, one steel-blue accent used as a line or a single figure. Large light-weight sans-serif headline in sentence case, monospace only for figures, units and standard codes. Square corners, hairline 1–1.5 px rules and line drawings, numbered items, generous negative space. Calm, precise, engineered. Show one idea clearly with at most five labelled items.
suf: This should look like award-winning web design (Awwwards Site of the Day): genuinely original, one memorable central idea that explains the content, strong typographic hierarchy, bold use of scale and space. Keep text to short labels. Show the whole section. Avoid: no bold or heavy headline, no condensed display type, no italic display, no all-caps headline, no monospace body text, no rounded corners, no pills, no glow, no bloom, no neon, no lens flare, no gradients except a faint ground, no drop shadows, no glossy reflections, no photographs, no stock props, no clipboards, no toolboxes, no laptops, no people, no lab coats, no water splashes, no droplets, no molecules, no globes, no stainless steel, no tri-clamps, no orbital welding, no distillation columns, no steam generators, no red, no green, no orange, no beige, no kraft paper, no device frame, no micro text, no duplicated labels, no slogans, no decorative connector lines.
directions: isometric technical line drawing of white polypropylene equipment, catalogue illustration, uniform hairline strokes, isolated on the ground, no shading, no hatching
technical blueprint on deep navy, pale blue-white hairline line art, one continuous double-line pipe in steel blue linking every item, P&ID valve symbols at the joints
engineering drawing sheet on navy, zone-reference border and title block, mono document codes, hairline table rules
limestone paper drawing sheet with a fine navy border, title block bottom right, navy hairline diagram, numbered notes in a narrow column
instrument-panel readout: one oversized light numeral with its unit, a fine tick scale and a single limit line with a small outlined limit tag
editorial magazine spread, dramatic asymmetric layout, oversized light-weight headline cropped by the frame, one striking line-drawn figure, hairline rules
Swiss International Typographic Style, strict modular grid of square navy and limestone tiles, huge light numerals with slash, one tile holds a blueprint drawing
long page alternating navy drawing bands and limestone reading sheets, each band one picture
one matte white polypropylene skid in soft 3D isometric render, even studio light, translucent pale-blue water, hairline leader lines to labels
macro close-up of a polypropylene butt-fusion weld or membrane, duotone navy and limestone, shallow depth of field, crisp hairline annotations over it
